authorization: 2026-10-14: evidence-backed data collection, constraint reasoning and shortcut checks on Quest; train only after audit
appearance_and_layout: Two independently preassigned factors on the fixed early checkpoint schedule: negative separator direction (exit/entry) and positive-region side (both endpoints inside/neither inside). A source-seeded four-cell cycle has five instances of each factor per ten checkpoints. Regions have equal dimensions, EXACTLY the same vertical interval, and identical source/checkpoint-seeded stroke widths. Negative separation uses a horizontal axis; no available horizontal separation remains UNKNOWN. All bounds use only the current target/necessary-goal envelope plus the fixed 12 cm allowance; neither actual future actions nor readout scores determine their geometry.
views: Two opposing simulator-native external overviews, shared distance and fovy, fixed 55-degree elevation, focus at the midpoint of the two regions, source/checkpoint-seeded azimuth; fit all declared corners with a margin before either protected-color query
image_protocol_reason: V3 failed its fixed gate (linear 0.769, forest 0.8311). The already-declared diagnostic reached 0.860 with color centroids plus rule alone. V4 decouples positive-side placement from separator direction, enforces congruent same-height/same-width annotations under opposing views, and uses 448-pixel student images to address observed small-target visibility failures. Camera seed, source splits, native physics, guard proof and the 0.75 limit remain fixed.
object_receiver_region_reason: Native object-On requires XY distance <3 cm; the displayed fixed initial-receiver box allows 4 cm per axis. It is an explicit extra goal, not an assertion that a movable receiver stays fixed.
construction: Four direction-by-positive-side cells. The negative region encloses only the target or only the entire necessary material goal. Independently, the positive region encloses both endpoints or neither. Every actual positive still requires a complete legal source suffix that satisfies the displayed guard.
physical_scope: Noncolliding annotations only; every source action must retain its exact original physical hash and native task outcome
positive_evidence: Actual legal source suffix with native contact contract v2, native and synchronized task/fixed-goal success, and the complete protected material-center guard. Both-inside cases must actually remain within the positive region; a failed suffix remains UNKNOWN.
negative_evidence: Explicit closed-face separator: either the current material point is inside and the necessary goal outside, or the current point is outside and the entire orientation-enlarged necessary goal is inside. This extends the direction of the same topological proof, not the number of independent proof mechanisms.
negative_is_not: Unrestricted physical impossibility, policy failure or a solid-wall benchmark result
counterfactual_controls: same pixels with opposite rules and labels
same target category with both labels
identical task/rule text with both labels after region-color swap
Both target-inside states and target-outside states have witnessed positives and certified negatives within each data split
Both goal-inside and goal-outside states have both labels within each split
Initial target/goal envelope determines identical region dimensions for both construction modes; size alone cannot identify the mode by design at a fixed physical state
Negative direction and positive-region side vary independently; all four cells occur in every split
Both regions share vertical bounds and stroke widths, so their unobstructed projections exchange under the opposing cameras
grouping: All source repeats, checkpoints, region placements and appearance/rule variants remain in one ancestry split
rationale_gate: Actually visible target and destination sides relative to both colored boundaries, plus explicit rules. Every positive label needs its actual safe trajectory; explanations never present a hidden trajectory as student input.
scientific_limit: A controlled constraint-conditioned dataset with one separator mechanism; does not establish a need for generative reasoning or general feasibility prediction

shortcut_screen.test_usage: No test predictions during dataset screening
shortcut_screen.readouts: Fixed C=1 logistic regression and fixed 200-tree depth-4 forest, minimum leaf 8, on full joint features and on color-statistics-only and color-centroids-only rule interactions; original RGB-only and text-only checks retained
shortcut_screen.scope: Practical predeclared dataset screen, not a statistical proof of reasoning or generative-verifier necessity
shortcut_screen.reason_for_additional_readouts: Previously observed color-only shortcuts must not be hidden by a larger feature set; these extra fixed readouts are frozen before V4 fitting and share the unchanged 0.75 limit.

construction_revision_reason: Structural controls motivated by the failed V3 color-position diagnostic, frozen before any V4 rendering/model fitting. This is dataset development after validation rejection, not a favorable test result.
selection_balance_reason: Keep 600/200/200 rows and the original source splits. Within each split, exactly half of units use each negative direction and half each positive side. The four joint cells differ by at most one unit; globally their counts are 63/62/62/63. All four rule/color rows stay together.
review_image_policy: Review actual 448-pixel student images, not 224-pixel downsampled previews; captions are outside student PNGs. Color-swap segmentation and native camera stability remain mandatory.
